__________

[h1]What is truly going on here?[/h1]

The Jam Scrapz Collection was suppose to be a collection of our 'best' game jam submissions and repurpose them for commercial profit to make a living in this already declining US economy. Since we can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2097480?emclan=103582791472696535&emgid=3698063796882485697]no longer trust the company behind the "best engine on the planet"[/url], that obviously means JSC can no longer achieve the goal it solely existed for - honest profit and honest value, and it also means all motivation to complete the collection eventually waned. In addition to this, we have virtually no audience to develop or market this collection to (besides maybe a pocket few in single digits).

We learned from my mistake after wasting 5 years developing Qorena, a game that was also suppose to be commercial but due to misfortunate circumstances and a blunder on Steam during early access in 2020, the game was since doomed to a situation where making it free seemed to be the best course of action, so I did. Even then, We tried to be optimistic in hopes to turn the users who got the game free in early access into active player-traffic for the MP servers in the game. This ultimately proved futile. No matter what we did to improve the quality of the game, no one was playing; no one cared.

We do not want to make the same mistake with the Jam Scrapz Collection, so we decided to make concessions by cancelling the rest of the projects that were planned with this collection, including Episodes 2 and 3 of Gene-Soldier, to shorten development time. Better to just focus on the games already guaranteed for this collection than risk making anymore promises we couldn't keep.


Thank you to those who visited and tried the Jam Scrapz Collection at the 2023 Winter Steam Next Fest and those who stuck with us beyond that, up to this point.

If you like the games we make, you can check out [url=https://qore.world/]Qore World[/url]. This site is where most of our passion remains.

You can also check out the rest of our content on our [url=https://linktr.ee/NeotlEmpire]LinkTree[/url] if you prefer instead. We do more than develop video games.

notes.title: New Game: The Minesweeper
notes.notes:
You are Pvt. Buster Monroe, A minesweeper in the Federation Army.

Your mission is to clear a path through the minefields in the Great Desert. In most levels, you will have to find a mine detector to clear the mines, or carefully navigate through the field and avoid triggering any mines. You may encounter Dominion troops standing in your path. You are not trained for combat, so just evade them when you see them, and let the real infantrymen do the fighting.

Good luck, minesweeper!

___________

This is the final entry to the Jam Scrapz Collection. We planned to have more games into the collection however due to a recent turn of events occurring last year, those plans are now forfeit. The incentive is gone, and the motivation waned.

Thank you to those who stuck with us this long. If you like the games what we made, check out [url=https://qore.world/]Qore World[/url] instead. You will find most of our passion there.

notes.title: New Game: Valentide! II
notes.notes:
Valentine is back in the 3rd dimension!

You are Cordante Saint Valentine; an intergalactic agent of the Corde, a race of xenophobic bounty hunters and assassins sent to collect skulls to use in their 'Great Journey' expedition. You have been sent from your home planet, Amourium, to planet Tera (aka Earth) - the only planet not yet registered in the Amourian index, yet the Great Prophecy demands skulls of "homosapien origin" and the so-called "humans" are the key. You have been deployed by the council to collect as many of these skulls as possible and bring them back to your home planet.

Your mission is simple: kill as many humans as possible before the time runs out.

In a level, you only have 6 minutes to slaughter humanity on Valentine's Day, and in such short amount of time, the humans will do everything they can to eliminate you as well, from the local government, to state, federal, the army, and united nations all trying to hunting you down. Your allies from outer space may teleport powerups to help you complete your simple, yet gruesome mission.

Happy Valentine's Day folks!
​

notes.notes:

notes.title: New Game: Luminous
notes.notes:
Battle it out in this online multiplayer top-down arena game inside the house with two elemental players - light or dark. Who will emerge victorious?

Luminous is back and more polished than ever! A swift duel for supremacy and dominance. A spooky game of arm wrestling on drugs manufactured just in time for a good old Hallow's Eve with a few bottles of wine with the boys (or girls)!

notes.title: WE ARE DONE WITH EPIC GAMES: ALL Unreal Engine games will become FREE FOREVER.
notes.notes:
We have made an important announcement regarding all of our products actively being sold on all digital storefronts. Any that use Unreal Engine it are extremely affected.

The COMPLETE article can be read [url=https://neotlempire.com/2023/05/31/we-are-done-with-epic-games/]here[/url].

For those of you who are too busy or too lazy to read a two-page long sermon on what is happening, here is the [b]TL:DR[/b] version:

We have decided to do what many developers may consider "the unthinkable", or even "the utterly insane". From this day forth, we will begin the process to [b]convert ALL of our projects using any of the Unreal Engines into NON-COMMERCIAL ones or switch engines.[/b]

[list]
[*] ALL games using UE currently on storefronts will become [b]FREE[/b].

[*] ALL games using UE we have currently in development that meets or exceeds 50% of progress will also be released for [b]FREE[/b].

[*] ALL games using UE we have currently in development that exceeds below 50% of progress will be [b]RESTARTED[/b] using a [b]DIFFERENT[/b] engine. Our engine of choice will depend on the project type, platforms, and the scope.

[*] ANY new games we have planned on lineup but not yet started will be using a [b]DIFFERENT[/b] engine.
[/list]

We are MOVING FAR AWAY from Unreal Engine and abandoning Epic Games. We are moving on to greener pastures.

notes.title: Jam Scrapz Collection - Livestream II (Finale)
notes.notes:
[b]NOTE: We had to postpone the event further to Sunday at 2PM EST. Preparing the build for Gene-Soldier proved more a hassle than we originally thought. A power surge from heavy raining also corrupted progress on one of our levels forcing us to recreate and replace the lost progress. Still need to fix a few critical bugs and we will be ready to showcase this afternoon. Apologies for the inconvenience on these sudden delays.[/b]
______________

Greetings!

We will be playing through the fifth and final game of the showcase, Gene-Soldier. This is the special big one; the epic single player retro revival game to really shine the brightest from the Jam Scrapz Collection showcase! It will take several hours to complete the first episode. Two more episodes are planned and will arrive at later times, with EP2 arriving next year in Q2 2024.

If there is any time left in the stream after the playthrough, we will also replay some of the earlier games from the showcase that we played on Wednesday, especially Valentide! since it's respective holiday is just tomorrow and marks the early access release of JSC!

Thank you to those who participated in the first stream. We hope to see both new and old faces arrive to this second stream as well!

Like our work? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097480/Jam_Scrapz_Collection/][b]Wishlist our game![/b][/url]

notes.title: Jam Scrapz Collection - Livestream I
notes.notes:
[b]NOTE: We had to postpone the event further to Saturday at 10AM EST. We discovered a hideous bug in 99 Cracks that threatened progression of gameplay and we need to resolve this first before streaming.[/b]

Greetings!

We will be playing through the first four games of our showcase, including 99 Cracks: The Winter Fix, and if possible, preview the 5th and sole epic game of the handful, Gene-Soldier - which will be played exclusively and completely on Friday.

These two streams will be long as we play through all of the games currently available on the showcase for early access. We cannot predict exactly how long some of the games will take to complete, especially 99 Cracks.

We hope to see you there!
